origins.section: A Tied Model Has Many Optimal Plans, and "Optimal" Is a Range
One Solve With an ε Weight Works Only Between Two Bounds
Tie-Break Weights Must Repeat in Every Process and Separate the Plans

gates.says: all 3 of this quiz's answerable readings held and each was taken over the question as it stands

recorded.prompt:q-gap: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-gap: "A MIP solver stops when its gap ... is within a tolerance, and reports OPTIMAL. Gurobi's default relative tolerance, MIPGap, is 10^-4 ... four objectives from 226,807 to 226,815: each was within 0.01% of the best bound, so each counted." Here 31/512,071 is about 0.006%, which is under 0.01%.
recorded.prompt:q-eps: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-eps: "The largest NPV any plan can have is at most S = Σ_i max_t npv_{i,t}, so any ε < 1/S is safe; the program uses 1/(S+1)." and "the upper bound is built: the smallest gap between two values of the first criterion (here 1...) divided by the largest value the second can add." Here S = 50×10 = 500, and 1/(S+1) = 1/501.
recorded.prompt:q-rank: Read the whole lesson page, then this question. Using only what the page states, which option does the page decide is correct? Quote or cite the deciding passage.
recorded.outcome:q-rank: "The rank weights repeat in every process, yet two different plans came back, both with tie-break weight 1,281: two plans can have the same total even when no two variables share a weight, and then the tie-break ties too."

recorded.prompt:q-gap:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap:a: "Even a model with one true optimum can return different 'optimal' plans under different settings unless the gap tolerance is 0". Both runs can be correct.
recorded.prompt:q-gap:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap:c: "A seed, by contrast, changes only the search path; the model, and so its true optimum, is the same for every seed."
recorded.prompt:q-gap:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-gap:d: Both runs report OPTIMAL, but a run stopped by a clock reports a time-limit status, as in 10.2.2's "Gurobi, TimeLimit=0.3 ... result.status TIME_LIMIT". The page explains different OPTIMAL values by the gap tolerance.
recorded.prompt:q-eps:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-eps:b: The bound divides by "the largest value the second can add", which is the total over the whole plan (S), not one crew's rating. The ε = 1e-3 example shows a large total outweighing a project: "the NPV term is worth up to 38 ... funded 32 projects".
recorded.prompt:q-eps:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-eps:c: The bound's denominator is the largest value the second criterion can add (S), not the number of variables: "divided by the largest value the second can add".
recorded.prompt:q-eps:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-eps:d: The gap tolerance sets the lower bound ("Too small, and the solver ignores it ... mip_rel_gap (default 10^-4)"), not the upper one. The upper limit is "ε < 1/S".
recorded.prompt:q-rank:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-rank:a: "The rank weights repeat in every process". 10.2.1 adds: "sorted() and a SHA-256 digest from hashlib do not [change], because they depend only on the characters."
recorded.prompt:q-rank:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-rank:b: Rank gives each key its own weight, r + 1 over sorted(keys), and the page says "no two variables share a weight".
recorded.prompt:q-rank:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-rank:c: The weights come from enumerate(sorted(keys)), and "sorted() ... [is] the same in every process", independent of build order. The output shows the weights repeating under set-order builds.
